description: Minimum test count per tier. A suite that shrinks without explanation is a silently disabled suite — a broken include glob drops the unit tier from 1024 tests to 3 and every other gate still passes, because total > 0, failed === 0 and success === true.
howToRaise: Raise a floor in the same commit that adds the tests. Lowering one is also a reviewable diff — state why in the commit message.
establishedBy: PR CI run 19 (run id 30431556718), artifacts `evidence-unit-coverage` / `evidence-security-matrix` / `evidence-integration-tests`, files `test-totals-unit.json`, `test-totals-database.json`, `test-totals-backend.json`, at feature head 8d7bfff09cf914e00ff5ff4587341ece261185c3, started 2026-07-29T07:24:48Z, GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest. All three tiers now carry a hosted measurement; none is a local or carried-over figure.
enforcementNote: Only `minTests` is enforced — summarise-vitest.mjs fails a tier that runs fewer. `measured` is provenance: it records what the named run actually observed, so a later reader can see how much headroom a floor had when it was set.

unit.note: Raised from 1000 to 1050. Run 19 measured 1082 on a hosted runner, replacing the local 1024 that established the old floor. The floor keeps roughly 30 tests of headroom for ordinary churn while no longer sitting 82 below the real count, where it could have absorbed an entire deleted test file without complaint.

web.note: RAISED to 2295 by the P1-28 Wave E/F/G/H integration. The raise was FORCED, not chosen: the tier now DECLARES 1917 cases on disk across 91 files, and `WTF-08` refuses a floor beneath cases that physically exist — the previous floor of 1800 sat 117 below them. `measured` moves with it, to 2375, and the pair is now a LOCAL measurement of this tree rather than the P1-27 hosted 1867 it replaces. That is stated as the weaker evidence it is, in `measurementProvenance` and here: 1867 was taken by a named hosted run against a smaller tree and could not stay, because a floor of 2295 above a measurement of 1867 is a contradiction the baseline-integrity rule refuses outright. Keeping 1867 was not available; presenting a local figure as hosted was not either. The next hosted run of this branch replaces both, and `measurementProvenance` names that as the thing that replaces it. TRACEABILITY of the figure this replaces, kept rather than dropped: the hosted 1867 was taken on PR #214 by GitHub-hosted run 31514783205, job 93857184798 (`Web quality / web-quality`, artifact `evidence-web-quality`, file `test-totals-web.json`). The 2375 that stands here now has NO run id, because it has no hosted run — that absence is the whole content of the LOCAL label, and it is why the note names the superseded run rather than pretending to name a current one.
web.whatTheHeadroomGuarantees: THE FLOOR DETECTS ANY NET LOSS OF MORE THAN 80 EXECUTED TESTS. That is measured (2375) minus the floor (2295), stated as the bound it actually is. The largest web test file declares 84 cases (api-client.test.ts), so the headroom sits below it and deleting that file trips the floor. Both tensions are satisfied: headroom above 0 so the floor is not a transcript of its own run, and below the largest file so the deletion guarantee holds.
web.measuredFilesNote: `measuredFiles` is 91 — physical test files, matching the tier as this branch holds it, and moved with `measured` so the two describe one run. It read 379 once, because `summarise()` populated it from `numTotalTestSuites`, which vitest sets to every `describe` block recursively. `measuredSuites` is retained so a reader comparing against an older artifact can see which number changed meaning rather than assuming the tier shrank.
web.measurementProvenance: LOCAL, and weaker than what stood here. 2375 is what `node scripts/ci/check-p1-27-closing-values.mjs --record web` observed on this branch at 55a24ca0dd3e973ba381f78c9631e8d207928e78: 91 files, 2375 executed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 todo, recorded in `docs/phase-1/phase-1-27/evidence/local-run-ledger.json`. WHAT REPLACES IT: the next HOSTED `Web quality / web-quality` run of this branch, whose `test-totals-web.json` is the figure QA-005 binds — exactly as the P1-27 hosted measurement replaced the local 1586 before it. This REPLACES the hosted 1867 established at 424e5d884ed7c8f608c446408743cbf88ac80515 by GitHub-hosted run 31508526699, job 93836261711, and re-confirmed at 03e84f1f244252903569619de72481f30238e76a by run 31514783205, job 93857184798. That figure was not wrong and was not abandoned lightly: it measured a 70-file tree, and this tree declares 1917 cases across 91 files, so a floor high enough to sit above the code that exists could no longer fit beneath it. The downgrade from HOSTED to LOCAL is recorded rather than hidden, because a local figure presented as a hosted one is the defect this field exists to prevent.

unitFloorCaveat: The unit floor is deliberately NOT set to the measurement of the run that carries this commit. This change adds twenty tests — eight in tests/ci/dependency-path-proof.test.ts (AR-49), four in the workflow-security rule-registry suite (AR-50), four in tests/ci/baseline-integrity.test.ts covering the baselines established here, and four in tests/ci/documented-counts.test.ts (AR-51) — so the final head measures 1102, not the 1082 recorded above. Setting 1102 as the floor would make it a transcript of the last run rather than a guard, and every future commit would have to move it. 1050 is the guard; 1082 stays as the provenance of run 19. Note that this sentence is itself the kind of hand-written count AR-51 was about, which is why the floor and the provenance figure — the two values anything actually reads — are measured rather than narrated.
